description: Going back may be a one-way action. So the visit to a dying parent is weighed against a residence permit, a career and a marriage, and the person decides not to go, and then lives with having decided that.
energy_note: Choosing your life over your mother's last week.

aspect: Military service as a permanent tether
description: An unresolved conscription obligation makes return an arrest. It attaches specifically to men and does not expire on any schedule the person controls.
energy_note: A border you are legally free to cross once.

aspect: Being unable to return corrodes the identity claim
description: Over years, a person who cannot go back stops being able to speak about the place in the present tense. They become an expert on a country that no longer exists in the form they knew.
energy_note: A citizen of a place that has moved on without you.

aspect: SECONDARY - it distorts every political opinion
description: Those who cannot return hold positions with no personal cost attached; those inside pay for every position. The resulting mutual contempt splits diaspora communities permanently.
energy_note: Opinions from people who will never pay for them.
